description: Analyze Korean text morphologically and tag parts of speech.

auto_jointing.description: When true, join separated jamo automatically before analysis.

auto_spacing.description: When true, apply automatic spacing correction before analysis.

auto_split_sentence.description: When true, split the text into sentences automatically before analysis.

custom_dict_names.description: Names of custom dictionaries to apply during analysis.

encoding.description: Text encoding for the analysis: utf32, utf16, or utf8.

with_sense.description: When true, include word-sense information in the result.

name: analyze_syntax
